name: HHH - Fasting Reminders
_notes: 1. In n8n Settings > Variables, add two environment variables:
SUPABASE_URL = (same value as your Vercel SUPABASE_URL, without /rest/v1)
2. Create a Telegram credential named 'HHH Telegram Bot' using your bot token from BotFather.
3. Run migration 037_telegram_fasting.sql in Supabase SQL Editor before activating.
4. Activate the workflow — it will check every hour on the hour.
REMINDER LOGIC (per user, per their local timezone):
1 hour before fast starts  → warning to finish eating
At fast start hour         → fast has begun notification
1 hour before eating opens → prep reminder
At eating window open      → break fast notification
2 hours after eating opens → energy check-in (reply 1-5)
If a user has no reminder matching the current hour, no message is sent.
If no users have reminders enabled, the Code node returns empty and Telegram node never fires.
